source.title: Open Problems in the Geometry and Analysis of Banach Spaces

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6587723. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identifies the exact work as the 2016 Springer book Open Problems in the Geometry and Analysis of Banach Spaces, with DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-33572-8.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged for direct local shell access to zbmath.org and api.zbmath.org, paywalled_or_restricted for the Springer DOI/book/chapter pages, and metadata_only for Springer previews, ResearchGate, ISBN/catalog pages, and resolver records. The Springer page confirms the title, authors, DOI, publisher, table of contents, and that the book is preview-of-subscription content, but it does not expose the problem statements needed for extraction. The direct Springer full-book PDF endpoint redirected to the paywalled book landing page. Exact-work searches by DOI, exact title plus PDF, ISBN 9783319335728, and the zbMATH identifier found only metadata, purchase/library pages, abstract previews, or unauthorized mirror copies; those candidates were rejected as extraction sources.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered, so no candidate questions were extracted. Extraction from abstracts, citation metadata, catalog records, search snippets, reviews, or unauthorized mirror text was rejected under the source adequacy and evidence completeness gates.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/6587723.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
